skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.use: Keep your balance, tumble, and squeeze through a tight spot.

skills.name: Animal Handling
skills.use: Calm a scared animal, or tell what it wants.

skills.name: Arcana
skills.use: Know spells, magic items, and other planes.

skills.name: Deception
skills.use: Tell a lie and make it sound true.

skills.name: History
skills.use: Remember old stories, kingdoms, and wars.

skills.name: Insight
skills.use: Tell when someone is hiding what they feel.

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.use: Scare someone into doing what you want.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.use: Search a room and figure out what happened.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.use: Spot a sickness and help someone who is hurt.

skills.name: Nature
skills.use: Know plants, animals, weather, and the wild.

skills.name: Perception
skills.use: Notice a sound, a smell, or something hiding.

skills.name: Performance
skills.use: Play, sing, or act so people pay attention.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.use: Talk someone into being friendly and helpful.

skills.name: Religion
skills.use: Know gods, prayers, and holy symbols.

skills.name: Sleight of Hand
skills.use: Hide a small thing, or pick a pocket.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.use: Sneak by without being seen or heard.

skills.name: Survival
skills.use: Follow tracks, find food, and not get lost.

Nature magic and turning into animals.

card.desc: Poison only does half damage to you.

card.name: Dwarven Toughness
card.desc: +1 HP every level (already counted).

card.name: Dwarven Armor Training
card.desc: You can wear light and medium armor.

card.name: Stonecunning
card.desc: You know stonework: who built it, how old, and where the secret doors might be.

card.name: Darkvision
card.desc: See in the dark up to 60 ft.

card.name: Fey Ancestry
card.desc: Advantage against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

card.name: Fleet of Foot
card.desc: 35 ft speed (already counted).

card.name: Mask of the Wild
card.desc: You can hide in light rain, falling leaves, mist or tall grass.

card.name: Elf Magic: Fire Bolt
card.desc: Throw fire (120 ft): {INTATK} to hit, {CD}d10 fire. Use it as much as you want.

card.name: Lucky
card.desc: Roll a 1 on a d20? Roll it again!

card.name: Brave & Nimble
card.desc: Advantage against being frightened. You can walk right through the space of bigger creatures.

card.name: Naturally Stealthy
card.desc: You can hide behind someone bigger than you.

card.name: Stout Resilience
card.desc: Poison only does half damage to you, and you're hard to poison.

card.name: Darkvision
card.desc: See in the dark up to 60 ft.

card.name: Gnome Cunning
card.desc: Advantage on Int, Wis and Cha saves against magic.

card.name: Gnome Illusions
card.desc: Make a fake sound or a fake little object (Minor Illusion), any time.

card.name: Speak with Small Beasts
card.desc: Chat with squirrels, mice, birds and other little animals.

card.name: Tinker
card.desc: Build tiny clockwork toys: a music box, a fire starter, a walking wind-up critter.

card.name: Darkvision
card.desc: See in the dark up to 60 ft.

card.name: Relentless Endurance
card.desc: When you drop to 0 HP, drop to 1 instead!

card.name: Savage Attacks
card.desc: When you crit with a melee weapon, roll one extra weapon die.

card.name: Darkvision
card.desc: See in the dark up to 60 ft.

card.name: Hellish Resistance
card.desc: Fire only does half damage to you.

card.name: Infernal Legacy
card.desc: You know Thaumaturgy: a booming voice, flickering flames, shaking ground.

card.name: Hellish Rebuke (racial)
card.desc: Someone hurts you? Burst them with fire: Dex save (DC {CHADC}) or 3d10 fire, half if they save.

card.name: Darkness (racial)
card.desc: Make a 15-ft bubble of magical darkness for 10 minutes.

card.name: Breath Weapon
card.desc: Breathe {DBTYPE}! {DBDICE}d6 damage in a {DBSHAPE}. {DBSAVE} save (DC {CONDC}), half if they save.

card.name: Dragon Hide
card.desc: {DBTYPE} damage only does half damage to you.

card.name: Rage
card.desc: Get SUPER angry for 1 minute: +{RAGEDMG} damage on Strength hits, advantage on Strength checks and saves, and weapons only do half damage to you.

card.name: Unarmored Defense
card.desc: No armor needed: Armor = 10 + Dex + Con (already counted).

card.name: Reckless Attack
card.desc: Swing wild! Advantage on your Strength attacks this turn, but enemies get advantage on you until your next turn.

card.name: Danger Sense
card.desc: Advantage on Dex saves against things you can see: traps, explosions, spells.

card.name: Feral Instinct
card.desc: Advantage on initiative. Can't be caught off guard if you rage.

card.name: Frenzy
card.desc: While raging, make one extra attack as a bonus action every turn. You'll be wiped out (exhausted) after.

card.name: Mindless Rage
card.desc: While raging you can't be charmed or frightened.

card.name: Spirit Seeker
card.desc: You can talk to animals (Speak with Animals) as a 10-minute ritual.

card.name: Bardic Inspiration
card.desc: Cheer on a friend within 60 ft: they get a {BIDIE} to add to one attack, check or save.

card.name: Jack of All Trades
card.desc: Add +{HALFPROF} to checks you're not trained in.

card.name: Song of Rest
card.desc: Friends who heal during a short rest get +{SONG} extra HP.

card.name: Expertise
card.desc: Double bonus in two skills (already on your sheet).

card.name: Countercharm
card.desc: Start a song: you and friends within 30 ft get advantage on saves against fear and charm.

card.name: Cutting Words
card.desc: When an enemy within 60 ft rolls, spend an Inspiration: subtract a {BIDIE} from its roll!

card.name: Magical Secrets
card.desc: You stole two spells from other classes: Fireball and Counterspell.

card.name: Combat Inspiration
card.desc: Friends can also add your Inspiration die to damage, or to their Armor against one hit.

card.name: Extra Attack
card.desc: When you take the Attack action, you attack {ATK} times!

card.name: Channel Divinity
card.desc: Holy power! Use it for Turn Undead or your domain's special move.

card.name: Turn Undead
card.desc: Undead within 30 ft make a Wis save (DC {DC}) or run away from you for 1 minute.

card.name: Destroy Undead
card.desc: Weak undead (like zombies) that fail Turn Undead are destroyed!

card.name: Disciple of Life
card.desc: Your healing spells heal extra: +2 + the spell's level.

card.name: Preserve Life
card.desc: Channel Divinity: heal {PRESERVE} HP split among friends within 30 ft.

card.name: Blessed Healer
card.desc: When you heal someone else, you heal 2 + spell level too.

card.name: Warding Flare
card.desc: Flash bright light when something attacks you: it gets disadvantage.

card.name: Radiance of the Dawn
card.desc: Channel Divinity: sunlight bursts out! Enemies within 30 ft: Con save or 2d10+{LVL} radiant (half on save).

card.name: Improved Flare
card.desc: Use Warding Flare to protect friends too.

card.name: Druidic
card.desc: You know the secret druid language.

card.name: Wild Shape
card.desc: Turn into an animal you've seen (up to CR {WSCR}) for {WSHOURS} hour(s). Use its body and HP; when that runs out, you pop back.

card.name: Combat Wild Shape
card.desc: Wild Shape as a bonus action. As an animal, spend a spell slot to heal 1d8 per slot level.

card.name: Primal Strike
card.desc: Your animal attacks count as magical.

card.name: Natural Recovery
card.desc: During a short rest, get back spell slots adding up to {RECOVER} levels.

card.name: Circle Spells
card.desc: Forest magic is always ready for you (marked as bonus spells).

card.name: Land's Stride
card.desc: Plants and rough ground don't slow you down or scratch you.

card.name: Second Wind
card.desc: Catch your breath: heal 1d10+{LVL}.

card.name: Action Surge
card.desc: Take one whole extra action on your turn!

card.name: Improved Critical
card.desc: You crit on a 19 OR 20!

card.name: Remarkable Athlete
card.desc: +{HALFPROFUP} on Str, Dex and Con checks you're not trained in; you jump farther.

card.name: Superiority Dice
card.desc: Spend a {SUPDIE} to pull off a maneuver. Enemies save against DC {MANDC}.

card.name: Know Your Enemy
card.desc: Watch a creature for 1 minute to learn if it's stronger or weaker than you.

card.name: Unarmored Defense
card.desc: No armor: Armor = 10 + Dex + Wis (already counted).

card.name: Martial Arts
card.desc: After you attack, punch once more as a bonus action: {MA}{DEX}.

card.name: Ki
card.desc: Special energy for your moves. Comes back after a short rest.

card.name: Flurry of Blows
card.desc: 1 ki: after attacking, punch TWICE with your bonus action.

card.name: Patient Defense
card.desc: 1 ki: Dodge. Attacks against you have disadvantage.

card.name: Step of the Wind
card.desc: 1 ki: Dash or Disengage, and jump twice as far.

card.name: Deflect Missiles
card.desc: Arrow or rock hits you? Reduce the damage by 1d10{DEX}+{LVL}. If it hits 0, catch it and throw it back (1 ki).

card.name: Slow Fall
card.desc: Take {SLOWFALL} less falling damage.

card.name: Stunning Strike
card.desc: 1 ki: when you hit, the target makes a Con save (DC {DC_WIS}) or is STUNNED until the end of your next turn.

card.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
card.desc: Your punches count as magical.

card.name: Evasion
card.desc: Dex save for half? Succeed: take nothing. Fail: take half.

card.name: Open Hand Technique
card.desc: When Flurry of Blows hits, pick one: knock it down (Dex save), push it 15 ft (Str save), or it can't react.

card.name: Wholeness of Body
card.desc: Heal yourself {WHOLE} HP.

card.name: Shadow Arts
card.desc: 2 ki: cast Darkness, Darkvision, Pass without Trace or Silence.

card.name: Shadow Step
card.desc: In dim light or darkness, teleport 60 ft to another shadow and get advantage on your next hit.

card.name: Divine Sense
card.desc: Sense celestials, fiends and undead within 60 ft.

card.name: Lay on Hands
card.desc: Touch to heal from a pool of {LOH} HP. Spend 5 to cure poison or sickness.

card.name: Divine Smite
card.desc: When you hit, spend a spell slot: +2d8 radiant (+1d8 per slot level above 1st, +1d8 vs undead and fiends).

card.name: Divine Health
card.desc: You never get sick.

card.name: Channel Divinity
card.desc: Holy power for your oath's special moves.

card.name: Aura of Protection
card.desc: You and friends within {AURA} ft add {CHA} to every saving throw!

card.name: Sacred Weapon
card.desc: Channel Divinity: for 1 minute add {CHA} to your attacks, and your weapon glows.

card.name: Turn the Unholy
card.desc: Channel Divinity: fiends and undead within 30 ft make a Wis save (DC {DC}) or run away.

card.name: Aura of Devotion
card.desc: You and friends within 10 ft can't be charmed.

card.name: Vow of Enmity
card.desc: Channel Divinity: advantage on attacks against one creature for 1 minute.

card.name: Abjure Enemy
card.desc: Channel Divinity: one creature makes a Wis save (DC {DC}) or is frightened and can't move.

card.name: Relentless Avenger
card.desc: When you hit with an opportunity attack, you can also move half your speed.

card.name: Primeval Awareness
card.desc: Spend a spell slot to sense fey, fiends, undead, dragons and other strange creatures within 1 mile.

card.name: Ranger's Companion
card.desc: An animal friend (like a wolf) fights beside you. Use your action to tell it to attack, Dash, Dodge or Help. It adds +{PROF} to its rolls.

card.name: Exceptional Training
card.desc: Tell your companion to Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help as a bonus action. Its bites count as magical.

card.name: Sneak Attack
card.desc: Once per turn, +{SNEAK}d6 damage with a finesse or ranged weapon if you have advantage OR a friend is next to the target.

card.name: Thieves' Cant
card.desc: A secret thief code: hidden messages in normal talk and secret signs.

card.name: Expertise
card.desc: Double bonus in your chosen skills (already on your sheet).

card.name: Cunning Action
card.desc: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

card.name: Uncanny Dodge
card.desc: When an attack you can see hits you, take half damage.

card.name: Evasion
card.desc: Dex save for half? Succeed: take nothing. Fail: take half.

card.name: Fast Hands
card.desc: Pick a lock, disarm a trap or use an item as a bonus action.

card.name: Second-Story Work
card.desc: Climb as fast as you walk; jump extra far.

card.name: Assassinate
card.desc: Advantage on attacks against creatures that haven't gone yet. Hits on surprised creatures are critical hits!

card.name: Sorcery Points
card.desc: Turn 2/3/5 points into a level 1/2/3 spell slot, or turn a slot into points.

card.name: Dragon Scales
card.desc: +1 HP every level and Armor 13 + Dex without armor (already counted).

card.name: Elemental Affinity
card.desc: Add {CHA} to {ELEMENT} spell damage. Spend 1 point to shrug off {ELEMENT} for an hour.

card.name: Wild Magic Surge
card.desc: After you cast a spell, the DM may have you roll a d20. On a 1, something random and magical happens!

card.name: Tides of Chaos
card.desc: Give yourself advantage on one roll. The DM can trigger a surge to give it back.

card.name: Bend Luck
card.desc: 2 sorcery points: add or subtract 1d4 from someone's roll.

card.name: Pact Magic
card.desc: Your spell slots come back after a SHORT rest!

card.name: Dark One's Blessing
card.desc: Drop an enemy to 0 HP: gain {DOB} temporary HP.

card.name: Dark One's Own Luck
card.desc: Add a d10 to one check or save.

card.name: Fey Presence
card.desc: Creatures in a 10-ft cube make a Wis save (DC {DC}) or are charmed or frightened (your pick) until your next turn.

card.name: Misty Escape
card.desc: When you get hurt, turn invisible and teleport up to 60 ft.

card.name: Arcane Recovery
card.desc: Once a day during a short rest, get back spell slots adding up to {RECOVER} levels.

card.name: Spellbook
card.desc: Find a scroll or spellbook? Copy new spells into yours!

card.name: Sculpt Spells
card.desc: Friends caught in your blasts automatically save and take NO damage.

card.name: Potent Cantrip
card.desc: Enemies that save against your cantrips still take half damage.

card.name: Arcane Ward
card.desc: Casting a protection spell (like Shield or Mage Armor) gives you a magic ward with {WARD} HP that soaks damage first.

card.name: Projected Ward
card.desc: Use your ward to soak damage for a friend within 30 ft.

card.name: Brutal Critical
card.desc: A critical hit with a melee weapon deals one extra damage die. Even more at higher levels.

card.name: Relentless Rage
card.desc: If rage would drop you to 0 HP, make a Con save (DC 10) to stay at 1 HP. The DC goes up each time.

card.name: Persistent Rage
card.desc: Your rage keeps going until time runs out, unless you stop it or fall unconscious.

card.name: Indomitable
card.desc: Reroll a saving throw you failed. You must use the new roll.

card.name: Action Surge Twice
card.desc: You can take that extra action twice between rests.

card.name: Purity of Body
card.desc: You can't be poisoned or get sick.

card.name: Diamond Soul
card.desc: You are trained in every saving throw, and you can reroll a failed save by spending 1 ki.

card.name: Empty Body
card.desc: 4 ki: turn invisible for 1 minute, and you resist all damage except force.

card.name: Aura of Courage
card.desc: You and friends within 10 ft can't be frightened.

card.name: Cleansing Touch
card.desc: End a spell on yourself or a friend you touch.

card.name: Land's Stride
card.desc: Brush, plants, and magical plants don't slow you down.

card.name: Hide in Plain Sight
card.desc: Spend a minute camouflaging yourself, then hide even while someone is watching.

card.name: Vanish
card.desc: Hide as a bonus action, and you can't be tracked by nonmagical means.

card.name: Feral Senses
card.desc: You know where an invisible creature within 30 ft is, if it isn't behind total cover.

card.name: Foe Slayer
card.desc: Once on each of your turns, add Wisdom to the attack or damage of one weapon hit.

card.name: Reliable Talent
card.desc: When you are trained in a check, a roll of 9 or less counts as a 10.

card.name: Blindsense
card.desc: You know where a hidden or invisible creature within 10 ft is, if you can hear.

card.name: Slippery Mind
card.desc: You are trained in Wisdom saving throws.

card.name: Elusive
card.desc: No attack has advantage against you unless you are incapacitated.

card.name: Stroke of Luck
card.desc: Turn a miss into a hit, or turn a failed ability check into a 20.

card.name: Magical Secrets
card.desc: Learn two spells from any class (and more at levels 14 and 18).

card.name: Superior Inspiration
card.desc: If you roll initiative with no Bardic Inspiration left, you get one back.

card.name: Divine Intervention
card.desc: Ask your deity for help. The chance is your cleric level out of 100. It always works at level 20.

card.name: Beast Spells
card.desc: You can cast spells in beast shape, even ones that need words or hands.

card.name: Archdruid
card.desc: Wild Shape uses no charges, and your spells ignore verbal, somatic, and free material needs.

card.name: Sorcerous Restoration
card.desc: When you finish a short rest, regain 4 sorcery points.

card.name: Mystic Arcanum
card.desc: You learn a 6th-level spell and can cast it once per long rest. You add a 7th, 8th, and 9th at levels 13, 15, and 17.

card.name: Eldritch Master
card.desc: Ask your patron for help: spend a minute and get your pact slots back.

card.name: Spell Mastery
card.desc: Pick a 1st-level and a 2nd-level spell. You can cast them at will, at their lowest level.

card.name: Signature Spells
card.desc: Pick two 3rd-level spells. You can cast each once without a slot, and the slots come back on a short rest.

options.name: Subtle Spell
